test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has an error in its tense. Identify the error and select the correct sentence from the given options.

I will be arrange all the necessary materials for the programme.

options.text: I was arrange all the necessary materials for the programme.
I would arranging all the necessary materials for the programme.
I is arrange all the necessary materials for the programme.
I will be arranging all the necessary materials for the programme.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the future continuous tense is used incorrectly.
 
• The correct form should be **"I will be arranging"** to **indicate an action that will be ongoing in the future.**
 
• None of the other options correctly convey the intended future continuous tense of the sentence.

Hence, the correct statement is "*I will be arranging all the necessary materials for the programme."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **future continuous** tense is used to describe actions that will be happening at a specific time in the future.
 
• It is formed using** "will be**" followed by the **"-ing" **form of the verb.
 
• **Example:** *At this time tomorrow, I will be** flying** to New York.*
